 5.3 Mohammad Sayyam to Lakshya Raichandani, 1 run, to square leg 5.2 4 Mohammad Sayyam to Lakshya Raichandani, FOUR , pitched up by Sayyam and the Indian captain offers a vertical blade to play a good-looking straight drive. Mid-off runs back and does well to flick the ball back in. But the mid-on fielder fails to support his team-mate 5.1 Mohammad Sayyam to Lakshya Raichandani, no run, Lakshya looks to punch and inside-edges this short of length ball onto his pad Over 5 22-0 0 4 0 0 0 0 ( 4 runs) Aaryavir Sehwag 14 (20) Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani 7 (10) Ali Raza 3-0-12-0 Over Summary View all overs 4.6 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, well-directed bouncer to end the over! Aaryavir Sehwag sways away from it. Bigger followthrough from Ali Raza, a testing over 4.5 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, zippy back of a length delivery, Aaryavir Sehwag hops to defend it into off 4.4 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, back of a length delivery wide of off, late inward movement but Aaryavir Sehwag shoulders arms 4.3 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, in-seamer, Aaryavir Sehwag walks forward to defend and gets hit high on the thigh. Even while he's outside his crease, Aaryavir uses his bat to push the ball away from him. Pakistan appeal for obstructing the field/hitting the ball twice, the umpire turns it down 4.2 4 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, FOUR , was that deliberate? Aaryavir Sehwag stands tall to punch with an opened bat-face. Once again, there's extra bounce from a short of length. The ball flies between slip and gully to race away to the fence. Now, gully moves to 2nd slip The physio comes out to tend to Aaryavir Sehwag. The Indian opener is fine to resume 4.1 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, optimistic shout for lbw, turned down! Pacy in-slanter that further nips back in. Aaryavir Sehwag is troubled by the pace and bounce. The ball beats the inside edge and hits his right forearm . The bottom hand was quick to come off the bat handle and he's in pain Over 4 18-0 1 0 0 1 0 1 ( 3 runs) Aaryavir Sehwag 10 (14) Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani 7 (10) Mohammad Sayyam 2-0-10-0 Over Summary View all overs 3.6 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, walks across, stands tall and opens the face of the bat to steer this away-angling short of length delivery to third man 3.5 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, short of length delivery around the sixth stump channel, a watchful leave from Aaryavir Sehwag follows after moving across in the crease 3.4 Mohammad Sayyam to Lakshya Raichandani, 1 run, back of a length, seams back in a bit, Lakshya hops and chops it to backward point's left 3.3 Mohammad Sayyam to Lakshya Raichandani, no run, good bounce from a fullish length outside off, zips off the deck and Lakshya Raichandani shoulders arms 3.2 Mohammad Sayyam to Lakshya Raichandani, no run, angling away outside off, left alone 3.1 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, extra bounce from a short of length outside off. Aaryavir Sehwag hangs back and nicely punches it behind square on the off-side. The third man fielder dives and somehow stops. In fact, the ball hits his chest. A slight hold up in play but he's fine to resume. Good job to prevent the boundary and keep the batters down to one Over 3 15-0 1 0 0 1 4 0 ( 6 runs) Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani 6 (7) Aaryavir Sehwag 8 (11) Ali Raza 2-0-8-0 Over Summary View all overs 2.6 Ali Raza to Lakshya Raichandani, no run, dug in short, the line is wide of off, Lakshya sway away from the line of the delivery 2.5 4 Ali Raza to Lakshya Raichandani, FOUR , first boundary for Lakshya Raichandani and that should boost his confidence. Harmless back of a length delivery wide of off. The Indian captain spots the length early, stands tall and cuts just in front of square on the off-side 2.4 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, very full and outside off, Aaryavir Sehwag squirts the drive to third man off the outer part of the bat 2.3 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, beaten! Extra bounce from a short of a good length. Aaryavir Sehwag gets into a tangle as he walks forward. The ball rushes on to him and he gets beaten on the outside edge as he tries to force it through the off-side. A slightly longer followthrough from Ali Raza on this occasion FEATURED VIDEOS
